title: Bravyi360 · Logical distance
summary: Independent binary-algebra checks on the 90-qubit base complex.
detail: The reported census contains 46 cycles below weight eight, all with checked boundary witnesses. Both boundary ranks are 41; a nontrivial weight-ten cycle supplies an upper bound.
scope: The X-sector interval has level R overall; the upper bound has level V. This is not an independent proof of the full 360-qubit distance.

title: Original and simplified Lean RH proofs
summary: A specification for statement preservation and proof correspondence across revisions.
detail: The report identifies 22 obligations and a six-link traceability framework. Identical definition text is reported, alongside a declaration-name discrepancy.
scope: Elaborated statement correspondence is open. Neither proof was compiled or independently replayed in this investigation.

title: Absolute convergence of transition amplitudes
summary: Hilbert-space composition and convergence in a null-cone quantization proposal.
detail: The report recovers the single-cut composition relation and convergence estimate. Bounded operators suffice for absolute convergence; contractions suffice for the stated norm bound.
scope: No Lean or RLT proof certificate has been completed. The derivation does not establish gravitational realization or unrestricted trace finiteness.

title: Surface intersections and singularities
summary: Independent symbolic investigation of an orthogonal-circle ruled surface.
detail: A nonzero Whitney determinant at the positive interior singular label supports a cross-cap classification under the classical criterion; symmetry supplies the reflected case.
scope: The image-germ conclusion also requires a singleton-fibre argument. No Lean rebuild was performed.

title: Riemann Hypothesis · Statement and proof
summary: Separate external proof acceptance, exact statements and correspondence.
detail: The page records the Lean and Mathlib communities’ reported verification and identifies source identity, axioms, proof checking and statement correspondence as distinct obligations.
scope: RLT has not independently replayed the full external development. The structural reformulation is a separate mathematical project.

title: Math 378 · Positive-rate ETH
summary: A Lean bridge between bounded-width SAT and a formal positive-rate ETH predicate.
detail: The bridge addresses encoding, machine simulation, polynomial overhead and the exponential-rate comparison. The source page identifies the final declaration and pinned proof revision.
scope: The result concerns the specified formal predicate and its exact correspondence; broader complexity-theory claims require their own statement checks.

title: Attention-head expressivity
summary: Formal extensions of the symmetric Boolean function head-complexity characterization.
detail: Four extensions are reported published on the fork; a fifth patch has been checked but publication is pending in the source record. The work concerns a specified one-layer model.
scope: The model’s assumptions limit the result; it does not characterize all Transformers or measured training efficiency.

title: IntelligenceRegulation · Private inference
summary: Independent verification of conditional proof terms and implementation evidence.
detail: The source audit reports 496 individual module checks, four accepted theorem exports in nanoda and four axiom-removal controls.
scope: The proofs retain their premises; implementation correspondence and deployment security remain separate questions.

title: [C]Worthy · Ocean carbon removal
summary: Source-linked verification across UCLA-ROMS, ROMS-Tools and C-Star.
detail: The research record describes numerical and workflow corrections, scientific findings and reproducible evidence prepared for upstream review.
scope: Prepared contributions are not necessarily accepted upstream. Model and software checks do not establish observed physical carbon removal.
